scope: Second targeted closure pass over previously researched municipalities with article/form/legal residuals.

records.closureSearchResult: Current municipal product pages now provide a coherent activity/application matrix. Woningvorming requires a municipal permit and at least a substantiation of current/new situation plus building drawings when rebuilding. Onttrekking covers office use, merging, demolition and room rental and has an explicit evidence list. A separate omgevingsvergunning may be needed; its page gives DigiD/eHerkenning, drawing types, scales, current/new situation, possible soil investigation and decision periods. Housing permit/opkoopbescherming page supplies current thresholds, fees and base documents.
closedNonAddressItems: housing-permit base documents and current product fees
remaining: dynamic extra documents for the selected activity/address

records.closureSearchResult: Current municipal woningsplitsing product confirms the substantive splitting route: independent dwellings, own entrance/facilities, each over 75 m2, public-road access, good living environment, spatial/landscape fit and additional monument/protected-village conditions. Omgevingsvergunning via Omgevingsloket is mandatory. Splitting-side generic research is closed.
remaining: specific current ordinary room-rental form/checklist if applicable

records.closureSearchResult: Current municipal stock-removal product explicitly covers room rental, merging, demolition and non-residential use. It provides a concrete evidence matrix: current rent/purchase price, room count, area, floor and maintenance state; for changed use the new use, building drawing/omgevingsvergunning and compensation proposal; for merging new price, new occupant, number of occupants and tenant consent. A separate omgevingsvergunning may also be required. This closes the generic application-package residual.

remaining: representative address applicability under current recovered splitting/room-rental policy
